text.tspan: SQL catalog row pages are accumulated in a private structure-of-arrays builder, then published as one immutable generation.
Every *Sym column stores an integer into this table.
owner indexes join dependent rows; no per-item heap-object tree
pin one generation for the whole response
never mix N and N+1 during one operation
read methods perform no I/O and no mutation
cached only for the current generation
never included in the persistent payload
Private mutable build -> atomic CatalogSnapshot -> pinned generation -> synchronous consumer reads
